cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Skills 合集领跑日增榜
anthropics/skills 还在加速
cover.dek: 前十名里大半是技能集合，anthropics/skills 近两天分别涨了 725 和 1,007 颗星，今天又加 1,178。装 skill 之前先扫描的 SkillSpector，也已连续 70 天稳定增长。
cover.title_en:
Skills collections lead the daily chart
and anthropics/skills is still speeding up
cover.dek_en: Most of the top ten are skill collections. anthropics/skills gained 725 and 1,007 stars over the last two days, then another 1,178 today. SkillSpector, which scans skills before you install them, has grown steadily for 70 days.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Coca-Cola 把工具输出压成隐 token,token 消耗降低 70.01% 到 89.24%。
stickers.text_en: Coca-Cola compresses tool output into latent tokens and cuts token use by 70.01% to 89.24%.

stickers.title: 进化遗忘
stickers.text: harness 持续自进化后,SWE-Bench 从 94.0% 掉到 32.0%。
stickers.text_en: After continued self-evolution, a harness fell from 94.0% to 32.0% on SWE-Bench.

stickers.title: HN 热帖
stickers.text: Goldman Sachs 把 Claude Code 从银行家和交易员那里撤掉,HN 上 858 分、463 条评论。
stickers.text_en: Goldman Sachs pulled Claude Code from bankers and traders, drawing 858 points and 463 comments on HN.
